title: Grandleon Stat Line Range
notes: A negative skill, evasion, luck or magic is an author meaning something the rules cannot express. The hit chance is a sum clamped to nought and a hundred, so a negative skill would read as a striker who is worse than their own weapon and a negative evasion as a target who is easier to hit than open air — neither of which is a thing the vocabulary says. They are refused where the author can still see them, exactly as an out-of-range accuracy or growth chance is, and the growth chance for the same stats is bounded on its own terms beside them.
